description: Verifies the quadrupole gravitational wave strain of a binary neutron star system at face-on inclination: the plus polarization dominates at orbital phase zero, the cross polarization dominates at a quarter-turn phase, and each suppressed polarization vanishes relative to the dominant one.

checks.label: the plus polarization is non-zero at phase zero
the cross polarization vanishes relative to the plus polarization at phase zero

checks.section: Orbital phase of a quarter of a half turn
checks.label: the cross polarization is non-zero at phase pi/4

checks.section: Orbital phase of a quarter of a half turn
checks.label: the plus polarization vanishes relative to the cross polarization at phase pi/4

measurements.section: Orbital phase of a quarter of a half turn
measurements.name: h_cross_phase_quarter
